text:
The issue is that your endpoint is configured as `https://ollama.com/api`, which results in an HTTP 404 error.

According to the onboarding documentation, Ollama Cloud requires the endpoint **`https://ollama.com/v1`**.

### How to Fix:
Update your `~/.hermes/config.yaml` configuration to point to the correct endpoint:

```yaml
model:
  provider: ollama-cloud
  base_url: https://ollama.com/v1
```
